name: UI Layouts Pro
summary: Paid React and Tailwind block library: page sections plus full templates and a drag-and-drop template builder.
description: A paid library of ready-made page sections (hero, features, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, footer, team, newsletter, carousel) built with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS, installed with shadcn commands or copied. It also offers complete multi-page site templates (Certific, MVP Studio, Jenv, UploadThing, TalentFlow and more) and a drag-and-drop template builder that exports production-ready templates.
